name: MetaMask Agent Wallet
tagline: Official MetaMask skills and plugin that let AI coding agents run a crypto wallet through the `mm` CLI.
description: MetaMask Agent Wallet gives AI agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity, and Grok Build a crypto wallet through the MetaMask Agent Wallet CLI (`mm`, npm `@metamask/agent-wallet`). One skill covers auth, wallets and balances, transfers, message and typed-data signing, token swaps, cross-chain bridges, perpetual futures, prediction markets, DeFi earn vaults, EVM calldata decoding, and x402 pay-per-request payments. It ships as a plugin for each agent host, with a session-start readiness check that never installs software. The agent asks before installing the CLI and confirms before any action that moves funds. Open source under MIT.
